args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent healthy production release (the only newer version, `v2.3.1`, was the failing one).

3. **Rolled back**: Deployed `v2.3.0` to all production regions — verified successful.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident `INC-0001` for `checkout-api`, paging on-call, describing the health-check failures and the rollback to `v2.3.0`.
